preconditions.description: Input k is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() in ['N', 'Y'] * n for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The adjacency matrix consists only of 'N' or 'Y' characters.
The first line of output is an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 1000) representing the number of vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i][j] == 'N' for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i == j)
postconditions.description: The adjacency matrix is diagonal-free (Gii = 'N' for all i).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i][j] == stdout.splitlines()[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: The adjacency matrix is symmetric (Gij = Gji for all i, j).

postconditions.expression: any(stdout.splitlines()[i][j] == 'Y' for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j)
postconditions.description: The graph is connected (at least one edge exists).
The output consists of exactly n+1 lines (1 for n, n for the adjacency matrix).

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.strip()) == n for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each row of the adjacency matrix has exactly n characters.
The number of shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2 in the constructed graph is exactly k, where k is the input integer.
